in_marathi.name: Dhawal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhawal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhawal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhau' which means 'sun'. The name signifies the rising sun and represents new beginnings, light, and energy.

in_bengali.name: Dhawal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Rising Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhawal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Dhawal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhau' which means 'sun'. The name signifies the rising sun and represents new beginnings, light, and energy.
